scope: strict/loose uRPF, single selected next-hop, synthetic 5AS, IPv4 and IPv6
units: 2 fresh namespace rebuilds per address family on one VM; packets and rebuilds are technical checks, not independent scientific replicates
order_reason: dependency-ordered causal fault/recovery sequence, address-family order reversed between repeats; no population effect estimate
controls: no-SAV packet before first manual enable
automatic boot installation; disable pauses; enable resumes
unchanged FIB and advancing counters do not reinstall
physical link down/up changes BIRD and FIB, Agent refreshes without manual install
unknown source drops after automatic update; legitimate traffic passes
missing and altered nft table repaired with unchanged FIB
FIB exit error, malformed JSON and timeout retain prior rules and recover
nft invalid atomic transaction and timeout retain prior rules then retry
failed disable returns error and remains paused
dry-run does not change installed generation or resume
auto application switch strict/loose with install=false
loose uRPF automatically permits added source prefix then denies its withdrawal
packets: 10 checked UDP datagrams per probe, about 20 packets/sec, isolated namespaced endpoints only
evidence: commands JSONL, status snapshots, real FIB/BIRD/nft dumps, raw receiver stdout, exact probe tokens, binary/source hashes, independent verifier and negative controls
